text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The words "fastest of the era" told by 
Sakura Bakushin O repeatedly crossed K.S. 
Miracle's mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, K.S.Miracle bears witness to 
Yamanin Zephyr's sharp and fierce running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr admits she recognized 
K.S.Miracle as a formidable rival and was 
always conscious of her. Now, the two will 
finally compete on the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though overwhelmed, K.S.Miracle couldn't 
contain the pounding in her chest. The 
tempestuous Yasuda Kinen is about to 
begin—!
